**2B.4 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** I found one real de-escalatory signal, but the broader 2024 record leans against strong respect for civilian protection, necessity, and proportionality. The clearest evidence is Khamenei publicly celebrating the April strike on Israel and later urging allies to intensify anti-Israel struggle. I found no direct 2024 primary-source evidence on prisoner treatment in military operations.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran` | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan; Reuters said this appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the strongest 2024 signal of restraint and proportionality. | `2B.4`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |
| `Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike on Israel, called it proof of Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. This frames military action as prestige and leverage, not narrowly necessary defense. | `2B.4`, `1B.1`, `1B.8`, `2B.2` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | Khamenei called on regional allies to intensify resistance against Israel and said strikes served the region and humanity. That is evidence of prolonging conflict and justifying expanded proxy pressure, not careful proportionality. | `2B.4`, `2B.2`, `1B.8`, `1B.6` |
| `Iranian commander warns Tehran could review 'nuclear doctrine' amid Israeli threats` | Reuters | 2024-04-18 | [link](https://www.yahoo.com/news/iranian-commander-warns-tehran-could-114201991.html) | A senior IRGC commander in charge of nuclear security said Israeli threats could push Tehran to review and deviate from doctrine. This is brinkmanship language, showing military-security decisions being framed around threat escalation rather than restraint. | `2B.4`, `1B.2`, `1B.3`, `1B.5` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors, after Iran removed many experienced inspectors. While not a battlefield issue, it undercuts a picture of disciplined, rule-bound state behavior in sensitive security matters. | `2B.4`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |

**Assessment**

- **Positive evidence:** the April 19 no-retaliation response is a genuine de-escalatory signal.
- **Negative evidence:** the April 21 and October 5 statements are hard to reconcile with a strict civilian-protection or proportionality standard.
- **Net reading:** the available 2024 evidence is **mixed but leaning negative** for 2B.4.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find reliable 2024 primary-source evidence on:
  - explicit civilian-targeting rules,
  - prisoner treatment in military operations,
  - written proportionality guidance,
  - or operational civilian-protection directives from Khamenei.
- Most available evidence is rhetoric about Israel, not concrete military-law compliance.
